description: Questions about this repository and the files a good answer needs in context. File level, so a question is satisfied by any symbol in the file. AUTHORED BY THE ASSISTANT that wrote the retrieval prototype, not by an independent labeller: treat results as indicative. 'named' questions use words that also appear in the files' names; 'paraphrase' questions avoid them. Replace this file with your own questions to measure your own repository.

questions.question: How is the quality gate policy evaluated for a pull request?

How are hotspots ranked from git history?
How is a program dependence graph built for a function?
How are invariants inferred from guards?
How are test results and coverage artifacts parsed?
How does the chat agent call read-only tools?
How is a forge webhook verified and applied?
How do we stop a hosted model from receiving code the user has not approved?
Where do we decide whether a displayed statement is grounded in evidence?
How do we run untrusted tests without letting them touch the rest of the disk?
What turns a defect report into a reviewed patch and a draft request on the forge?
How does the system remember what a model called each group of similar functions?
How do we find every place a symbol is used across several repositories?
Where do we turn a plain-language feature request into checkable requirements?
How is it decided what is in scope for a release and whether it is ready?
What is reused and what is rebuilt when a small edit is made and the build runs again?
